profile.headline: Software Engineer at Perceptionist
profile.summary:
I design, development, test and maintain integrations with our Call Center Software and applications used by our customers. SQL Server, C#, ASP.Net and REST API development skills well be used to enhance customer interactions. I am self-motivated and a quick learner. Work with dynamic yet lean team of subject matter experts and managers to build next generation of Call Center software. I can ensure the integrity, accuracy and quality of data and reports. I provide quality communication to all levels of the organization as well as manage and mentor existing junior staff.

My skills:
- Proficient in C#, with a good knowledge of its ecosystems
- Familiarity with the .NET framework
- Strong understanding of REST API integrations
- Skill for writing reusable C# libraries
- Expert with Microsoft SQL Server
- Familiarity with Windows Communication Framework

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Founded over 19 years ago, Perceptionist has become one of the largest North American providers of small business call center services. We provide a way for businesses to capture 100% of their sales opportunities by providing overflow sales support during days, evenings, and weekends. Instead of sending customers to voicemail, calls are redirected to a team of specially trained sales representatives who know your business and have the skills to close the sale.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Chepri Technologists provide high quality web, mobile and kiosk development solutions specifically for corporate brands, chains, and franchisors with rapid results. With over 10 years of experience, Chepri brings omni-channel, industry-specific app development experience to every client we serve. We like to say, “we turn our customers into partners,"​ by producing apps that keep on winning across every device, hardware platform, browser or display.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: HMB is an IT solutions firm with offices in Columbus, OH and Louisville, KY that helps mid-to-large-sized enterprises deliver custom technology solutions to their biggest challenges.  We specialize in providing Professional Services, Fax & Digital Transformation solutions and developing niche software products.
